image_prompt.text: A hollow open carnival slime shaft with a completely empty air core — only the rim, the walls and the ledges jutting inward are solid — about 100 studs deep and 40 studs wide, banded from rim through shallow and mid walls to deep walls and the abyss floor
The whole slime pit as common ground every player on the server dives into for slime and prizes, refilling on its own rather than belonging to anybody's plot

10+ carnival props jutting inward across the whole depth — floating balloon clusters, striped tent-pole obstacles, confetti-covered ledge chokepoints, a hanging prize ribbon, a popcorn cart platform, a ticket booth ledge, and colorful Neon light-bulb strings strung across the deep walls
A swinging ferris wheel gear arm slung right across the mid shaft and a spinning carousel fragment turning out from the deep wall, both blocking the descent
Slime as the pit's liquid — bubblegum-pink slime coating the shallow walls, thickening down the shaft into a deep purple slime pool covering the solid abyss floor
Tent-flap cave mouths cut into the mid walls and entered straight off the shaft, plus the Slime Vault chamber at the bottom
A rim ring of red and white striped circus tent panels and poles around the top of the shaft in bright SmoothPlastic, with no natural rock or grass anywhere on it
A glowing prize-treasure Slime Vault set into the abyss floor at the very bottom, lit by drifting confetti particle glow
Festive Roblox tycoon low-poly styling throughout — chunky primitives, vivid carnival colors, SmoothPlastic and Neon materials

layout_placement.text: The slime globs and carnival prize tokens the dive loop runs on, placed along the jutting ledges and cave mouths so they get denser the deeper the band
Depth bands kept as separate folders — Rim, Shallow, Mid, Deep, Abyss, Water

notes: Dominant genre is Simulation on the prompt's own word 'slime tycoon'; Obby & Platformer is named second only for the obstacle course running down the shaft, so its genre-wide P6 does not follow it into the mix and no `path-track` was taken.
Preset Mining & Extraction kept with its shape `world-underground`; `path-road-vehicle` dropped because a hollow shaft with an empty air core has no room for hauling roads or vehicles.
The pit is a shared resource field, not a plot — it is common ground the whole server draws from, and building it as one player's plot breaks the loop.

P2 and P3 are both earned by explicit statements, not assumed: ledges, the gear arm, the popcorn cart platform and the carousel fragment all overhang the empty core, and the tent-flap cave mouths plus the Slime Vault are entered from the shaft. Neither modifier is ready to build yet, so this route is a deferral rather than a build today.

CHECK comes from `water-body`. It is probably benign here — the slime is a wall coating plus a floor pool over a representable surface, not a swum volume — but a 100-stud shaft ringed with inward ledges is the self-occluding case worth looking at.
The ledges were read as obstacles, not as a physics-validated descent route, so no P6 was added. If players are meant to platform down them, `path-track` and P6 belong here.
Stated scale ~100 studs deep by 40 wide carried in the shaft text; there is no numeric field for shaft dimensions.
